newsitem.title: USA: Daschle says U.S. budget amendment vote is close.
newsitem.headline: Daschle says U.S. budget amendment vote is close.

text.p: Senate Minority Leader Tom Daschle on Wednesday predicted a close vote on a proposed balanced budget amendment to the constitution, saying the outcome was "in the margins, it could go either way."
The Senate opens debate on the amendment later Wednesday.

"This is going to be a protracted debate. There will be many amendments, my guess is at least 10, maybe more," Daschle said. He estimated that a half-dozen Democrats had not yet decided how they would vote on the amendment.

As he did Tuesday, Daschle said he was optimistic that opponents of the amendment, himself included, were making headway with arguments that it could have detrimental effects on the Social Security trust fund and make it difficult for a future Congress to act in the face of an economic downturn.

"I'm more encouraged in the last couple of days than I have been ... I think we're making points," he said. "I think that the people who are genuinely undecided have indicated these are concerns that they share."
